title: Homemade Cranberry Stuffing
description: Classic oven-baked stuffing of toasted bread cubes, butter-softened onion and celery, sage, thyme and rosemary, studded with sweet-tart dried cranberries.

ingredients.note: sweet onion if you can, finely chopped
chicken or vegetable; use only as much as you need (1½–2 cups)

steps.heading: Toast the Bread
steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 dish. Spread the bread cubes on a sheet pan and toast 10 to 15 minutes until dry and golden, then let them cool.

steps.heading: Soften the Vegetables
steps.text: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion and celery 8 to 10 minutes, until soft and translucent.

steps.heading: Combine
steps.text: In a large bowl, toss the bread with the onion and celery (and all the butter), the herbs, salt, pepper and cranberries.

steps.heading: Moisten
steps.text: Pour in the broth a little at a time, folding gently, until the bread is damp but not mushy. Then stir in the eggs.

steps.heading: Bake Covered
steps.text: Spread it in the dish, cover with foil and bake 30 minutes.

steps.heading: Crisp the Top
steps.text: Uncover and bake about 20 minutes more, until golden and crunchy on top. Let it sit a few minutes before serving.
